timeline.author: Luigi Dell'Aquila

timeline.body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/108777
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/108782

The test succeeded most of the time because `randomString LIKE randomPattern` was false most of the time, but in the construction of the expression we forgot to add a `*` to the random pattern
Does it also look like this would fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/108782?
I tested it and I can confirm that it doesn't reproduce with this fix. I'm adding it to the "Fixes" list
Did it just never match before? That seems bad!

If this is for a RLIKE, shouldn't it be `.*`?
```suggestion
                BytesRef pattern = new BytesRef(patternString + ".*");
```

reply.body: It's not rlike - it's just sharing some test cases with rlike.

timeline.body:
Thanks!

> Did it just never match before? That seems bad!

Yeah, the randomization is pretty unfair for negative cases
